services.desc: Our 2021 Bentley pontoons are equipped with a 90 hp motor and are ready to take you on your next adventure! Route 37 Watersports has everything you need to have some fun in the sun and make a splash in the water when you rent a boat. If you have a boater’s safety certificate please bring it with you. If not, no worries, we will provide the necessary certification on site at no additional charge! Experience fast-paced water adventure with easy jet ski rentals, safety training included, fuel provided, and fun for all

services.name: Banana Boat
services.desc: Hold on tight for an action-packed banana boat ride! Bounce across the waves, laugh with friends and family, and enjoy an unforgettable adventure that’s perfect for groups looking for fast-paced fun on the water. No experience necessary-just bring your sense of adventure! ALL CANCELLATIONS MUST BE MADE 72 HOURS BEFORE YOUR RENTAL FOR 100% REFUND. WITHIN 48 HOURS ONLY 80% WILL BE REFUNDED. WE RIDE IN THE RAIN AND THE WIND BUT NOT DURING THUNDERSTORMS. IF WE MUST CANCEL DUE TO INCLEMENT WEATHER WE WILL RESCHEDULE YOUR TOUR OR ISSUE A REFUND. IF YOU CHOOSE TO RESCHEDULE AND YOU DON’T ATTEND THE TOUR FOR ANY REASON, A REFUND WILL NOT BE ISSUED. YOU ARE EXPECTED TO ARRIVE AT THE CORRECT TOUR
